page.overview:
Who is Arn?

Medilia (wife) Link (eldest son) younger son

During Link's absence from Calatia, he received a notorious reputation. An impostor of Link had overthrown the kingdom of Calatia and imprisoned the queen, greatly shaming both Arn and Medilia. When the unsuspecting Link returns home to visit his family, he receives a violent greeting from Arn and is told to never show his face again, claiming that Link is no son of his. Shortly after, Link discovers the cause to this and set out to stop the impostor. After he succeeds, both Arn and Medilia apologize for their behavior and welcome him back.
